verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. All three lines are present, bundled in one theorem, with these recodings. (i) The variable is the local coordinate t = y - holdStart on the constant-slope interval, ranging over 0 ≤ t ≤ wait; the paper's y is the same local coordinate ('In the local logarithmic radial coordinate on the constant-slope interval'). (ii) The subtracted equilibrium is literally (λ - h + c_η)/(1-λ) with c_η = D·η·J₀' = Dη·2η/(1+η²), the paper's c_η = DηJ₀' ≍ η²; the source holdSource is the paper's λ - h + c_η - λLk̄(0)e^{-y} verbatim. (iii) O_{C¹_η} is unfolded into the two separate bounds on |Q_s - equilibrium| and on its η-derivative, both by C_pre(1+t)e^{-(1-λ)t}. (iv) The third line matches, and the derivative version without the factor |η| (the paper's following sentence, 'One η derivative obeys the same estimate without |η|') is the fifth clause. (v) Constants are explicit: c_pre = holdFloor m = min(e^{-3/5-entranceTime m}/16, 1/16), which depends only on m and not on λ, as the paper requires ('A positive lower bound for Q_s, independent of λ, persists'); C_pre = holdConstant P m.
